page.layout: One printed page of text, centre-left; a narrow strip of the facing page with margin notes at the right edge (partly cut off by the scan). Running head and page number at the top. Below the text block nothing else.

main_text.head: Quæstio XIX.
An legitimum sit judicium, quod de ignotis, ex incidente fortè cum iis colloquio, formamus?
main_text.p: SErmo dum animo consonat, interpres ejus, dum dissonat, plerumque proditor est: Nam si animi sensa, os inficiari audeat, statim ad equuleum ruboris à conscientia protractum, ipsis se accusat indiciis: quin etiam alia quædam à re, fatetur sæpenumerò, confusionis tormento perplexum, quæ nisi in fraudis odium fuissent extorta, puro puto silentio concessum erat occulere: Adeo commercium istud, quod Natura nobis sanxit, non impunè rescindi-

page.notes: The initial S is a woodcut ornamental letter, joined to "ermo" as "Sermo". The right-hand strip belongs to the facing page (catchword/running head "Quaest." and cut-off marginal text) and is largely illegible in the scan, so it is not transcribed. The text ends with the hyphenated word "rescindi-" continuing on the next page.
